citation: Menota AM-132-fol-Njals-saga 42v:35: participle of the report on Hǫskuldr's killing; cq1 report w10/8. Kaikki Old Norse vega (2) 'to fight, slay' < *wiganą < *weyk-, distinct from vega (1) 'weigh, carry' < *weganą < *weǵʰ-; Zoëga s.v. vega 2.
Menota AM-162-B-fol-kappa 2r:11 (Njáls saga, after the preposition í/til): the farm Tunga, unlemmatised document; same reading as the cq1 Tungu rule in lemmatised documents (report w10/56).
Menota AM-162-B-fol-kappa 2r:29 (Njáls saga, after the preposition í/til): the farm Tunga, unlemmatised document; same reading as the cq1 Tungu rule in lemmatised documents (report w10/56).
Menota AM-162-B-fol-kappa 2r:30 (Njáls saga, after the preposition í/til): the farm Tunga, unlemmatised document; same reading as the cq1 Tungu rule in lemmatised documents (report w10/56).

Menota AM-242-fol 27:12 (unlemmatised Snorra Edda codex): temporal phrase with the preposition í and fyrir dag, oblique singular of ótta 'the last part of the night before daybreak' (Kaikki Old Norse ótta row3947; Zoëga s.v. ótta), not the form-table eiga (áttu); cq1 report w10/100.
